adm_users_home:
👥 User management
Choose an option below.
adm_users_order_ask: Send an order number (for example #123) or the service’s panel username.
adm_users_order_invalid: Send a positive order number or a service username without spaces.
adm_users_not_found: No order was found in this shop.
adm_users_bulk_intro:
🔋 Mass data or time gift
Only active, non-trial services belonging to non-banned users in this shop qualify. Unlimited services in the chosen dimension and panels without gift support are excluded. Choose the gift type first; nothing changes without a preview and confirmation.
adm_users_bulk_ask_days: How many days? Send a number from 1 to 3650.
adm_users_bulk_ask_gb: How many gigabytes? Send a number from 1 to 100000.
adm_users_bulk_invalid: Send a valid value: 1–3650 days or 1–100000 GB.
adm_users_bulk_too_many: The service count exceeds the safe limit ({limit}). Use the web panel’s filters.
adm_users_bulk_empty: No service qualifies for this gift. Nothing changed.
adm_users_bulk_already: This request was already confirmed or canceled; it will not run twice.
adm_users_bulk_queued: ✅ Queued {count} operations. This does not mean every service succeeded; check Operation status for results.
